blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III led the House of Representatives on Friday in honoring the late Batanes Rep. Ciriaco “Jun” B. Gato Jr. “For three consecutive Congresses, the people of Batanes entrusted him with the privilege of representing them,” Dy said in his eulogy during the necrological service for Gato at the House. Gato’s years as a physician, Dy went on, shaped the way he approached his responsibilities as a legislator, particularly on issues involving public health. “As a doctor, he was used to listening to his patients.
